Surface-parity census must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) and disposition each as in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason
Config-effect contrast tests must prove each config key changes behavior through the real read path, not merely parsing

Contention triggers scoped to op-level semantics route by shape to existing shared suites: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones, write-storm/retry to storm suite, read-integrity-under-contention to reads-under-sync-contention harness
Behavioral gate findings require RED test first in the same change before the fix; residual-gap disposition sweep covers census out-of-scope slots and deferred advisories
